verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Meilisearch exposes stored documents and embeddings through semantic search and conversational interfaces from a single API. Embeddings are generated automatically when an embedder is configured, and hybrid search covers retrieval. Product pages position it as a RAG retrieval layer and offer conversational search with answers grounded in your own content. Missing for 10: in-depth API reference for the conversational/answer endpoint (configuration, LLM providers, streaming, citations), and independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG/conversational use.
